title: Lead Full stack Developer
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


This role for an experienced full\-stack lead engineer to provide people engineering SME and support to our business partners in the Asset Management. The candidate should be hands on in advanced programing, visualization, analytical models and algorithms. The candidate should demonstrate strong technical/problem solving skills, manage multiple projects collaboratively and ensure adherence to enterprise standards. You’ll work with smart, talented people across our business to create innovative, next\-generation cloud\-based applications, and analytics/models. You’ll be involved, hands\-on, through the entire development cycle. And you’ll redefine the way our traders, portfolio managers and analysts support our clients.
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer Lead with strong expertise in Python, React, SQL, and AWS to build and support scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for application design, development, testing, deployment, and production support while collaborating closely with business and technology teams.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Planning \& Analysis**

* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and project goals.
* Perform impact analysis, solution design, and effort estimation.
* Participate in code reviews and provide technical guidance to development teams

 **Design \& Development**

* Design and develop web applications using Python, React, SQL, and AWS
* Build REST APIs, backend services, and responsive user interfaces.
* Create technical designs, engineering specifications, and low\-level design documents
* Ensure adherence to coding standards and SDLC processes

 **Testing \& Deployment**

* Develop and execute unit tests
* Support integration, UAT, and production deployments
* Troubleshoot issues and provide timely resolution during testing and post\-production

 **Documentation \& Support**

* Maintain technical, operational, and project documentation.
* Provide production support and application enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to improve application performance, reliability, and scalability

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in software development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with: Python (Fast API, Flask, or Django)React.jsSQL (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway)
* Experience with REST APIs, Git, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
* AWS certification preferred.
* Experience working in cloud\-native and microservices\-based environments

 **In\-Office Collaboration**


We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

title: Lead Engineer - Full Stack
description:
**What the role is all about:**


We’re looking for a **Lead Engineer (5–8 years’ experience)** who acts as the technical anchor for a squad. This role is hands\-on and execution\-heavy, with accountability for delivering complex features, shaping solutions at a subsystem level, and ensuring high standards of quality, performance, and reliability in production.


The Lead Engineer operates primarily as a **strong tech enthusiast** , leading through technical depth rather than people management. Success in this role is defined by strong ownership of code and systems, pragmatic design decisions, predictable delivery, and the ability to lift the technical capability of the team through mentoring and example.


This role has strong visibility and impact, particularly in building and evolving REA’s advertising platforms and data\-driven products used at scale.


**Key Responsibilities:**


**Technical Execution:**


* Own and deliver complex, high\-impact features across the full stack.
* Write, review, debug, and test production\-grade code aligned with REA engineering standards.
* Lead by example in code quality, correctness, security, and maintainability.
* Actively participate in pairing, code reviews, unit testing, and secure deployments.
* Evaluate technical trade\-offs across performance, reliability, scalability, and time\-to\-value.
* Take accountability for technical deliverables from implementation through production.

**Design \& Architecture:**


* Design solutions aligned with established architectural patterns and system constraints.
* Contribute to subsystem\-level design and support broader architectural decisions.
* Drive technical spikes and proof\-of\-concepts where deeper validation is required.
* Collaborate with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers to ensure designs align with long\-term technical direction.

**System Ownership \& Operational Excellence:**


* Own the health of delivered systems in production, including reliability, performance, and observability.
* Identify and address operational risks, scalability concerns, and technical debt early.
* Support incident analysis, remediation, and continuous improvement of system resilience.
* Ensure delivered solutions are operable, supportable, and production ready.

**Delivery Leadership:**


* Contribute to planning, estimation, and sequencing of work to support predictable delivery.
* Identify risks and cross\-team dependencies early and help unblock the team.
* Partner with Engineering Managers, Product, and Delivery roles to balance scope, quality, and timelines.
* Support effective ways of working within the squad.

**People \& Technical Leadership:**


* Mentor and coach engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance.
* Share knowledge through technical sessions and informal coaching.
* Help raise the technical bar and reinforce strong engineering practices across the team.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and learning\-oriented team culture.

**What We’re Looking For:**


* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating full\-stack systems using modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems (React, Node.js).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex features and deliver them reliably to production.
* Solid system design skills with experience evolving systems over time.
* Strong experience with SQL databases and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).
* Hands\-on experience with AWS RDS or other managed relational database services.
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS), containers (Docker), and observability tooling.
* Good understanding of TDD, CI/CD, and modern delivery practices.
* Exposure to Media / AdTech domains (e.g., bidding platforms, DSPs/SSPs, tagging, CDPs, privacy\-enhancing technologies) is highly desirable.
* Ability to influence technical outcomes without formal authority.
* Clear communicator who collaborates effectively with cross\-functional and global teams.
* Pragmatic problem\-solver who balances doing things right with getting things done.
* Experience working with relational and/or non\-relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, DynamoDB).

**Bonus Skills:**


* Experience with GraphQL, PHP, Functional Programming, or AWS\-native architectures.
* Experience building systems that operate at scale and handle high\-throughput traffic.

**Why join REA Cyber City:**


* Work on globally impactful products used by millions.
* Be part of a growing global engineering organization with strong technical standards.
* Influence systems, teams, and culture from an early stage.
* Collaborate closely with global leaders and technologists.
* Grow as a people leader, delivery owner, and technology leader.

**The values we live by:**


Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

title: Full Stack Developer (AI-Focused) | Freshers Welcome
description:
**About Us**  
CoverYou Group is a fast\-growing startup building technology at the intersection of insurance, healthcare and professional protection. Our platforms serve thousands of doctors across India. We're a small, sharp team that ships quickly, and we're looking for a builder who wants real ownership from day one.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and ship end\-to\-end features across frontend, backend and database
* Develop internal tools, portals and dashboards used daily across sales, operations and finance
* Integrate AI into products and workflows using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini etc.)
* Use AI coding tools to move fast without cutting corners on quality
* Work directly with the Founders' Office to turn business problems into working products
* Own your work from idea to deployment and iterate on real user feedback

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one backend language (Node.js or Python)
* Hands\-on experience with React or Next.js
* Working knowledge of databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL or MongoDB)
* Practical exposure to AI/LLM APIs through projects, internships or hackathons
* Comfortable with Git and deploying apps (Vercel, AWS, Render or similar)
* A portfolio, GitHub or live projects you can show us

**Good to Have**

* Experience with prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases or AI agents
* Built something end\-to\-end that real people used
* Interest in fintech, insurtech or healthtech

**You'll Thrive Here If You**

* Like moving fast and are comfortable with changing priorities
* Figure things out on your own before asking
* Care about shipping things that actually get used
* Want to learn quickly in a high\-ownership environment

**Why Join Us**

* Direct exposure to founders and business decision\-making
* Real ownership of products from your first month
* Fast learning curve across tech, AI and business
* Growth path that scales with your impact

Pay: Up to ₹650,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: On the road

title: Senior IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Overview:**

The Full Stack Developer position provides technical expertise in building modern solutions using AI\-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, prototyping, development, testing, and documentation without compromising architecture, security, code quality, or accountability. The role expects reliable delivery of business outcomes with predictable quality, security, and operational readiness by reducing lead time from concept to production through automation, reusable patterns, and effective AI\-assisted engineering. Transformation using Production\-grade web applications and digital services that solve measurable business problems with reusable front\-end components, APIs, microservices, integration patterns, and engineering standards that improve delivery speed across teams. The ideal candidate should have experience expertise in .NET Core, React, Python, and Azure and should leverage GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and AI\-assisted development tools.


  
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
  

  

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.
  
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Lead end\-to\-end solution delivery, including technical discovery, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and post\-production support
* Build accessible, responsive, and high\-performing user experiences using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern UI practices
* Design and implement secure REST APIs using Microservices architecture with .NET / ASP.NET Core, C\#, Python, and FastAPI or Flask
* Engineer solutions using appropriate platform services, managed identities, secrets management, monitoring, and cost\-conscious design. Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms
* Integrate applications with Enterprise platforms, Relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) , Messaging services, and Third\-party APIs
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes (Preferred)
* Use GitHub Copilot, Cursor Prompt Engineering, AI\-Based Code Generation, Automated Unit Test Generation,
AI\-Assisted Debugging \& Refactoring to accelerate development tasks while retaining full ownership of design and code decisions. Create effective prompts and context patterns for code generation, refactoring, test creation, debugging, documentation, and technical discovery
* Validate AI\-generated output for correctness, maintainability, licensing, security, privacy, and alignment with enterprise standards before use. Establish automated quality controls through unit, integration, API, security, and regression testing
* Protect confidential information by following approved\-tool, data\-handling, and source\-code governance requirements
* Optimise and standardize by identifying repeatable AI\-assisted workflows and convert them into documented, measurable engineering practices rather than one\-off experimentation
* Apply security\-by\-design practices across authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency management, and secure coding
* Collaborate professionally with Business SMEs, Developers, Architects, product owners, UX, security, operations, and business stakeholders
* Product mindset with strong ownership from problem definition through production outcomes
* Sound engineering judgement and the ability to balance speed, risk, maintainability, and business value
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a disciplined approach to continuous learning and experimentation

  
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field
* 8\+ years total experience with 6\+ years of hands\-on full stack software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications
* Strong expertise in .NET / ASP.NET Core, C\#, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS and responsive design
* Proficiency in Python and at least one modern API framework such as FastAPI or Flask
* Demonstrated experience designing REST APIs, microservices, integration layers, and distributed application components
* Practical Azure experience, including App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, monitoring, identity, and deployment services
* Solid understanding of automated testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, Docker, application security, performance tuning, and observability
* Core exposure to GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Prompt Engineering, AI\-Based Code Generation
* Exposure to ITIL Principles and Change management process
